featured_reviews.name: Mubaraka Ebrahim
featured_reviews.review_text:
Went to Bloosom Studio about a month ago, recommended by two close friends of mine. Zainab, the owner was so accommodating, as I only had a day before leaving she rescheduled, so that she could take me.

I did the Organic Nano Gel Treatment. It is the first Organic Treatment in a gel form consisting of nanoparticles that penetrate deeply into the hair fiber and treat the hair without opening the Cuticle making it a fast & effective one-step system rebuilding treatment. Enriched with Seaweed Algae (rich in Vitamin A, B, C & E, Amino Acids & Antioxidants), Sunflower Oil (rich in fatty acids & antioxidants), and Rosehip Oil (rich in fatty acids like Omega 3 & Omega 6), combined with Organic Acids, increases the hydration aiding in reconstructing the fibre without damaging the hair. It is also called Magic Gel as it gives wonderful results. It provides a protective layer around the hair strands, prevents damage, resulting up to 100% straight, smoother, shinier and frizz-free hair.

I had nice waves in my hair, but the straight frizz free hair is pretty awesome too. But more importantly I did this treatment to help with my hair loss and truly it has really helped. I won't lie, I'm still lossing hair, but after her treatment and up keep with the shampoo and conditioner she recommends I have had substantially less hair fall and was very happy with the overall treatment. It's a small cozy place. Definitely worth it for me!
